test_title: PYST 5: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row facing towards the south (not necessarily in the same order). Q and R are immediate neighbour of each other. Q is at one of the extreme ends. P is fourth to the left of Q. U is not the immediate neighbour of either P or R. S is second to the right of V. Who is sitting on the immediate right of R?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Q is at one of the extreme ends.

2) P is fourth to the left of Q. 

3) Q and R are immediate neighbour of each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b1a44dee4854643d1ad09844b8b358e2509a530689f792d00d7038d1135cf3f.png] 

4) U is not the immediate neighbour of either P or R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/870924c61b82d6233651f192722514aa345006eb5d066c2d0aa9fec2a7e0635d.png] 

5) S is second to the right of V. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a422ad323bd513d004cceac42efe1366f3b092d856cc9697ab81cc1adaa6ecd.png] 

Here, we can see that Q is sitting on the immediate right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Q"**.
